visual_style.overall_tone: warm, magical, educational, Pixar-like underwater world
visual_style.art_direction: 2D stylized illustration with soft gradients, rounded shapes, gentle lighting. Similar to children's picture book meets modern animation concept art. NOT photorealistic.
visual_style.character_style: cute anthropomorphic sea creatures with expressive large eyes, simple facial features, soft body shapes. Approachable and friendly for children.
visual_style.background_style: layered underwater scenes with depth-of-field effect, light rays filtering through water surface, subtle particle effects (bubbles, plankton)
visual_style.lighting: warm bioluminescent glow mixed with natural sunlight filtering from above. Soft shadows, no harsh contrasts.

mulgyeol_character.description: 바다 요정, 큰 물방울 형태로 반짝이며 떠다님
mulgyeol_character.visual_prompt_base: a cute glowing water droplet fairy character named Mulgyeol, translucent blue body with sparkle effects, large expressive eyes, small crown of tiny bubbles, floating gracefully, friendly and magical appearance

emotions.bright: sparkling eyes, wide smile, radiating soft light
emotions.serious: slightly dimmed glow, focused expression, gentle frown
emotions.excited: intense sparkle, bouncing motion, bright golden highlights
emotions.mysterious: half-lidded eyes, swirling internal glow, purple-blue tones

prompt_rules.mandatory_prefix: Children's educational animation concept art, 2D stylized illustration,
prompt_rules.mandatory_suffix: soft lighting, pastel underwater palette, rounded shapes, Pixar-inspired, high quality, detailed
prompt_rules.negative_prompt: photorealistic, scary, dark horror, sharp edges, violent, blood, realistic human faces, 3D render, low quality, blurry, text, watermark
